name: BookLeaf – Royalty Summary (Bubble webhook → Gemini → Bubble)

parameters.content:
## BookLeaf Royalty Summary
Bubble → **POST** this webhook with header `X-BookLeaf-Key` and the author + books payload.

The reply *is* the status callback: Bubble writes `status`, `subject`, `body`, `error_*` and `completed_at` into its Notification Log from this response.

Invalid payload → 400 · duplicate → 200 `Skipped` · AI failure → 200 `Failed`.

### AI with failover
Groq gpt-oss-120b (~1 s typical; 10 s timeout, 2 retries 5 s apart for its 8k tokens/min limit) → Gemini 3.8 flash (20 s) → Gemini 3.5 flash-lite (20 s). Any error (503 overloaded, 429 quota, timeout) moves to the next provider; each has its own free-tier quota. All failing → `Failed` with the last reason. No Groq key configured? That step errors instantly and Gemini takes over.

### Email delivery (bonus)
Disabled by default. Enable it, set an SMTP credential (Gmail app password) and point **To** at your own test inbox. Sample author addresses are not real inboxes.
